# Contract: Audio Manifest & Playback (1.0.0)

**Generated by**: `tools/design/build-narration.mjs` from `docs/design/narration/lines.json` plus a
scan of `prototype/assets/audio/<lang>/`.

**Never edit by hand.** It is regenerated by `npm run check`.

## File: `prototype/assets/data/audio-manifest.js`

This is a classic script, so it works from `file://`, the same as the rest of the prototype.

```js
window.KC = window.KC || {};
KC.audioManifest = {
  version: '1.0.0',
  defaultLanguage: 'en-GH',
  regionLanguage: { gh: 'en-GH', ng: 'en-NG', uk: 'en-GB' },
  languages: ['en-GH', 'en-NG', 'en-GB'],
  text: { 'intro.say': 'Oh no! Coins are lost in the market.', /* … every line … */ },
  lines: {
    'en-GH': {
      'intro.say': { file: 'assets/audio/en-GH/intro.say.m4a', status: 'recorded' },
      'find.say':  { file: 'assets/audio/en-GH/find.say.m4a',  status: 'pending' }
      /* … every line ID … */
    },
    'en-NG': { /* every line ID, status pending until recorded */ },
    'en-GB': { /* … */ }
  }
};
```

**Rules**:

- **Every line ID exists in every language**, with a status of `recorded` (the file exists on
  disk) or `pending`. Slots for future languages are present from day one (FR-021).
- `file` is relative to `prototype/index.html`, and is always `assets/audio/<lang>/<lineId>.m4a`.
- `text` holds the caption for each line, taken from `lines.json`. The prototype's string table
  (`mock-data.js`) MUST NOT define narration text separately, so the script, the captions and the
  recordings can't drift apart.

## Dropping in a recording (FR-019, SC-008)

1. Save the file as `prototype/assets/audio/<lang>/<lineId>.m4a`.
2. Run `cd tools/design && npm run check`, or just `node build-narration.mjs`.
3. That line's status changes to `recorded`, and the prototype plays it. **No code changes.**

## Playback contract (`KC.voice`, in `prototype/assets/app.js`)

| Call | Behaviour |
|---|---|
| `KC.voice.play(lineId, vars?)` | Stops any current line, then picks a language: the region's language if `recorded`, else `defaultLanguage` if `recorded`, else **caption only**. Shows the `narration-caption` with the line text (vars filled in) and status `playing` or `pending`. Sets Kudi to `headphones` while playing and restores the previous pose after `ended` or `error`. Records `KC.voice.last = lineId` for the replay button. |
| `KC.voice.replay()` | `play(KC.voice.last)`. Wired to the header `replay-button` on every screen (FR-029). |
| `KC.voice.stop()` | Pauses and resets the element. Called on every navigation. A bottom-nav tap passes its label to `KC.go(route, { say })`, which plays it **in place of** the screen prompt, so it always finishes (003 FR-036). |
| Audio `error` event, or `play()` rejected | Falls back to the caption with status `pending`. **Never** synthesised (FR-016). |
| Sound off | No audio. The caption still shows, so the line can still be read. |

**Forbidden anywhere in `prototype/`**: `speechSynthesis`, `SpeechSynthesisUtterance`,
`webkitSpeech*`, and any text-to-speech API or service. This is checked by `check-no-tts.mjs` and
by a runtime stub in `flow.spec.mjs`.

## Caption states (`narration-caption` component)

| State | Shows |
|---|---|
| `playing` | The text and a moving headphones icon. Kudi is in `headphones`. |
| `pending` | The text and a **"Recording pending"** badge, in Mane Brown on Soft Gold. Kudi stays in the action's pose. |
| `hidden` | Nothing. Used before the first line plays on a screen. |

The caption sits under Kudi's bubble. It never covers the main action and never blocks taps.
